archetypes.name: dyn-commit-outcome
archetypes.rationale: Review the new commit outcome state machine and emitted KV contract.
archetypes.prompt_body: Focus on python/review_and_fix.py and its commit_fixes stage-all branches. Verify every success, no-op, and failure path emits a consistent COMMIT_OUTCOME and preserves the intended COMMITTED, SHA, and ERROR semantics. Pay special attention to probe failures and dirty trees after a successful pathspec commit. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-resume-gate
archetypes.rationale: Review wrapper and SKILL routing interactions for fail-closed handoff behavior.
archetypes.prompt_body: Focus on skills/implement/scripts/step-5-resume.sh and the Step 5/Step 7 SKILL.md prose. Verify line-anchored COMMIT_OUTCOME parsing cannot be satisfied by ERROR text and that successful commit KVs are not relayed before the porcelain gate. Check that Step 5 review-loop envelopes still own Step 6 continuation. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
